Accommodating

/uh-KOM-uh-day-ting/ - the stress falls on KOM · adjective

Hear It

What It Means

Accommodating means helpful and willing to adjust to what others need.

The campground host was endlessly accommodating, towing a spare picnic table to any site that asked for one.

Worked Example

When the beekeeper's truck rolled onto the noon ferry, the deckhand studied the hives, then re-parked six cars so the bees could cross in the shade of the wheelhouse. He found a cool corner for a crate of seedlings next, and radioed ahead so the dock crew would unload them first.

Accommodating is the exact word for the deckhand, because it means helpful and willing to adjust to what others need — he changes his own arrangements to fit each passenger. Polite is thinner: a polite deckhand would smile, wish the bees luck, and re-park nothing.

How Accommodating Sits Among Its Neighbors

Synonyms — open each to see how it differs

obliging

obliging: quick to do the favor asked of them

helpful

helpful: the plain word — useful aid, no reshuffling of plans required

Antonyms

unbending

unbending: refusing to move an inch off the plan

difficult

difficult: turning every request into a battle

How Strong Is It? — courteous → accommodating → selfless

courteous vs. accommodating

courteous vs. accommodating: Courteous is surface manners — a courteous clerk greets you warmly and still quotes the rulebook unchanged.

selfless vs. accommodating

selfless vs. accommodating: Selfless goes further than accommodating — the selfless host gives up her own plans entirely, while an accommodating one bends them to fit yours.

Build the Word

The pieces

Prefix — ac-

Prefix — ac-: to, toward (Latin ad-)

Prefix — com-

Prefix — com-: with, together

Root — mod

Root — mod: measure, fit (Latin modus)

Suffix — -ating

Suffix — -ating: adjective ending, from -ate + -ing

Put it together

Put it together: Ac- (to) + com- (with) + mod (measure) + -ating = measuring yourself to fit with someone. Latin accommodare meant to fit one thing to another, and an accommodating person still does exactly that: re-measures their own plans until yours fit inside them.

Use the root in a new word: modify

Use the root in a new word: modify: Pilots modify the flight plan when storms build — they re-measure it to fit the sky they actually have.

Root Check

Word Choice

warm / approving

Accommodating praises the willingness to rearrange your own plans around someone else's needs. Its unit-mates divide the work: tactful is about sparing feelings in what you say, lenient about softening punishments, and forbearance about keeping your cool. Reach for accommodating when the kindness shows up in changed arrangements — swapped rooms, moved dates, re-parked cars.
